body.title: Add the no-transport contract check and run the full test sweep
body.summary: Add a durable repo-wide grep test asserting no production file imports src/shared/vibe-session.js and the module no longer exists, so a future regression re-introducing the transport fails the suite immediately. Run the full relevant test sweep (src/agent/providers/**, src/shared/**, vscode-plugin's chat/plugin suites) plus typecheck to confirm no regression to any path this Story touched.
acceptanceChecks: the new contract test fails if src/shared/vibe-session.js is re-imported by any production file or the file is restored
the full relevant test sweep passes and typecheck is clean
